name: Nesting Grounds
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Move a counter from target permanent you control onto a second target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}: Move a counter from target permanent you control onto a second target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: a move_counters mode that moves ONE counter of a kind the controller chooses on resolution from among the kinds on the source ("move a counter"), e.g. `choose_kind: true` with `amount: {const: 1}`, removing it from the `from` target and adding the same kind to the `objects` target
needs.why_existing_wont_do: move_counters takes either a single printed `counter` kind (default +1/+1) or `all_kinds`, which moves the whole multiset; neither lets the player pick which one counter of any kind moves, so naming +1/+1 would make the land useless with charge/loyalty/oil counters and all_kinds moves every counter instead of one
